title: Carry-forward F&O cost price (Finspot OMS, NFO_COST_PRICE)
purpose: Each client's open NSE F&O positions at the previous business day's close with their average cost, so Finspot's MTM starts from the right price. Net quantity is signed (negative for a short position); the average rate is Ledgerline's average price of the open side. Instrument type OPTIDX, OPTSTK, FUTIDX or FUTSTK; for futures the strike is 0 and the option type XX, as in NSE's contract files (the sample shows options only). Unlike Finspot's other uploads this file has a header row and commas, as in the sample.
source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet NFO_COST_PRICE (8 columns, title line, header row, comma-delimited)
